categories.main_business_segments: Quang Viet Enterprise Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the manufacturing of high-end down jackets, resin cotton jackets, knitwear, and other functional apparel. The company also engages in the production and sale of down materials such as goose and duck down. It serves as an OEM/ODM manufacturer for globally renowned outdoor and sportswear brands, focusing on high-performance and fashion-integrated garments.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced manufacturing technologies including laser cutting, special tailoring, large-scale sewing, waterproof bonding, and automated filling. It has achieved approximately 80-90% automation in template-based production lines, integrating digitalization and AI training models to enhance efficiency and product quality. Vertical integration includes owning a down processing plant to ensure raw material quality and supply stability.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Quang Viet serves major international sports and outdoor brands such as Adidas, Nike, Patagonia, The North Face, Under Armour, and Lululemon. Its products cater to the outdoor, sports, and lifestyle apparel markets, focusing on high-functionality and fashion-conscious consumers. The company’s customer base is diversified across multiple global brands, reducing order concentration risk.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates production facilities in Vietnam (multiple plants), China (Zhejiang and Jiangsu provinces), Romania, and Jordan, with headquarters in Taipei, Taiwan. Its sales markets primarily include North America, Europe, Greater China (including Hong Kong), and Japan, with growing presence in other regions. The multi-country production footprint allows it to leverage trade agreements and mitigate geopolitical risks.
categories.supply_chain_position: Quang Viet operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the textile and apparel supply chain, focusing on garment manufacturing and assembly. It has vertically integrated upstream by investing in down material processing to secure raw material quality and supply. The company also collaborates closely with upstream suppliers for fabric and accessories, and downstream with brand customers for product development and delivery.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes continuous R&D and innovation in high-end down jackets and technical apparel, enhancing warmth, fashion, and functionality. It invests in automation and digitalization to improve production efficiency and reduce labor costs. Strategic focus includes expanding product categories such as knitwear, optimizing product mix for higher profitability, and deepening vertical integration to control raw material supply and costs. Sustainability and ESG initiatives are also integral to its long-term strategy.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through contract manufacturing (OEM/ODM) for international apparel brands, based on product orders and shipments. The company does not develop its own brands but earns income from manufacturing and supplying finished garments and down materials. It also derives income from its vertically integrated subsidiaries involved in raw material processing and related services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Quang Viet is positioned as a global leader in high-end down jacket manufacturing and technical apparel OEM/ODM services. It competes with other large-scale garment manufacturers in Asia and globally, leveraging its advanced production technology, vertical integration, and multi-regional manufacturing footprint. Its strong relationships with top international brands and diversified production bases provide competitive advantages in quality, cost, and supply chain resilience.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024 (FY113), the company reported net operating revenue of approximately NT$16.47 billion, slightly down 0.48% from the previous year. Net profit attributable to the company was NT$402 million, declining 45.25% due to increased operating costs and geopolitical uncertainties. The company employs over 21,800 employees with steady growth in production capacity. Despite recent profit pressure, it maintains stable revenue and plans capacity expansions in China, Vietnam, and Jordan to support future growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Quang Viet emphasizes high product quality, advanced manufacturing technology, and reliable delivery to build trusted partnerships with global brands. Its vertical integration ensures superior down material quality and supply stability, differentiating it from competitors. The company’s focus on automation, digitalization, and innovation enables cost efficiency and consistent product performance. Additionally, its multi-regional production strategy offers customers flexibility and tariff advantages, enhancing its value proposition.
